title: Plan Benefits and the Covered Pet
content:
Benefits of the Tailwise Vet Clinic Wellness Plans attach to the covered pet only. The plan's discount on clinic services not included in the plan and its discount on medications dispensed at the clinic apply to services and medications for the pet the plan covers, and never to another pet of the household, even if that other pet has its own plan.

A pet with a plan in status Active, under a plan that carries the grooming discount eligibility shown below, qualifies its grooming pass for the Tailwise Grooming Salon's wellness-plan discount.

## Clinic medication discount and grooming pass eligibility

| Plan | Discount on medications dispensed at the clinic | Pet qualifies for the grooming pass wellness-plan discount |
|---|---|---|
| Puppy Wellness Plan | 5% | No |
| Kitten Wellness Plan | 5% | No |
| Adult Dog Wellness Plan | 5% | Yes |
| Adult Cat Wellness Plan | 5% | Yes |
| Senior Dog Wellness Plan | 10% | Yes |
| Senior Cat Wellness Plan | 10% | Yes |

## Basis questions answered

**A customer holds a Senior Dog Wellness Plan for one dog; may the plan's discounts be used for a medication dispensed at the clinic for the household's cat, which holds no plan?**
No. The discounts belong to the covered dog; the cat is another pet of the household.

**Two dogs in one household each hold a plan — one an Adult Dog Wellness Plan, the other a Senior Dog Wellness Plan. Does the senior dog's 10% clinic medication discount apply to a medication for the adult dog?**
No. A plan's benefits never extend to another pet of the household, even one with its own plan; each plan's benefits attach to its own covered pet.

**Under which plans does an Active plan qualify the pet's grooming pass for the salon's wellness-plan discount?**
Under the Adult Dog, Adult Cat, Senior Dog and Senior Cat Wellness Plans: a pet with one of these plans in status Active qualifies its grooming pass. A pet under the Puppy or Kitten Wellness Plan does not qualify through that plan.

**Does a plan held by one pet qualify a different pet's grooming pass?**
No. The qualification attaches to the pet that holds the plan and to that pet's grooming pass.
